verdict.rationale: The only webhook-related evidence (mastra-docs-16) describes inbound handling: agent threads subscribe to external resources, and incoming webhook or polling events are routed into notification signals. That is an adjacent feature, not documented outbound HTTP callbacks that a programmatic consumer can register to receive Mastra events. The axis applies to a framework/platform like Mastra, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Subscribe agent threads to external resources and route webhook or polling events into notification signals.
